description: Essential smartwatch features with crash detection, heart rate monitoring, sleep stages tracking, Retina OLED display, swimproof 50m water resistance, and S8 SiP dual-core processor.

description: Now with a 6.8-inch glare-free 300 ppi display, adjustable warm light, up to 10 weeks of battery life, IPX8 waterproof rating, and 20% faster page turns for book lovers.

description: Brilliant AMOLED touchscreen display with advanced training metrics, HRV status, recovery insights, multi-band GNSS GPS, up to 13 days of battery in smartwatch mode, and music storage.

description: 15 customizable LCD keys to trigger unlimited actions with one touch. Control OBS, Twitch, YouTube, Spotify, Philips Hue, smart home, and productivity apps with detachable faceplate and stand.

description: High-speed SD card with up to 200MB/s read and 90MB/s write speeds, V30 and U3 ratings for flawless 4K UHD video recording, shockproof, temperature-proof, and X-ray proof.

name: Peak Design Everyday Backpack 20L V2

description: Ultra-thin 18mm 20,000mAh power bank designed for laptop portability. Dual USB-C and dual USB-A ports with real-time numeric power and time-remaining digital LED display.

description: Ultimate Thunderbolt 4 dock featuring 18 connectivity ports including 2.5GbE Ethernet, UHS-II SD/microSD slots, DisplayPort 1.4, three Thunderbolt 4 ports, and 98W host laptop charging.

name: Kiprun 500 by Coros GPS Multi-Sport Watch
description: Lightweight multi-sport GPS watch developed with Coros technology. Tracks heart rate, pace, cadence, interval training, and altitude with 25-hour full GPS battery life and 50m water resistance.

name: Belkin BoostCharge Pro 3-in-1 MagSafe Wireless Charging Stand
description: Official Apple 15W fast wireless charging stand for iPhone 15/14/13/12 series, Apple Watch Ultra/Series 9 fast charging, and dedicated wireless charging tray for AirPods.

name: Fitbit Charge 6 Advanced Fitness & Health Tracker
description: Premium fitness tracker with Google apps integration (Google Maps, Google Wallet), heart rate on exercise equipment, ECG app, EDA stress sensor, built-in GPS, and 7-day battery.

name: Atomic Habits by James Clear (Hardcover Edition)
description: An easy and proven way to build good habits and break bad ones. The definitive guide on behavioral change, tiny changes, and remarkable compound results for personal and professional growth.

name: The Psychology of Money by Morgan Housel
description: Timeless lessons on wealth, greed, and happiness. 19 short stories exploring the strange ways people think about money and teaching you how to make better sense of life's most important topic.

name: Designing Data-Intensive Applications by Martin Kleppmann
description: The big ideas behind reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems. Essential reading for software engineers and systems architects covering data models, replication, partitioning, and stream processing.

name: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship by Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship. Even bad code can function, but if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. Practical principles, patterns, and refactoring.

name: Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World by Cal Newport
description: Cal Newport argues that the ability to focus without distraction on a cognitively demanding task is becoming increasingly rare and vastly valuable in today's knowledge economy.

name: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari
description: 100,000 years ago, at least six human species inhabited the earth. Today there is just one: Homo sapiens. How did our species succeed in the battle for dominance? An international phenomenon.

name: Dune: Deluxe Collector's Edition by Frank Herbert
description: Frank Herbert's masterwork - the epic tale of triumph and betrayal on the desert planet of Arrakis. Deluxe hardcover edition with embossed cover, custom endpapers, and full-color planetary map.

name: Grokking Algorithms: An Illustrated Guide by Aditya Bhargava
description: A friendly and illustrated guide that teaches you how to apply common algorithms to practical problems in software development with over 400 illustrations and intuitive visual breakdowns.

name: Zero to One: Notes on Startups, or How to Build the Future by Peter Thiel
description: Legendary entrepreneur and investor Peter Thiel shows how we can find singular ways to create new things and build monopolistic startups that bring humanity from 0 to 1.

name: Steve Jobs: The Exclusive Biography by Walter Isaacson
description: Based on more than forty interviews with Jobs conducted over two years, Isaacson's acclaimed biography explores the rollercoaster life and searingly intense personality of a creative entrepreneur.

name: Moleskine Classic Hardcover Dotted Journal (Large, Black)
description: Classic large dotted notebook featuring ivory acid-free paper, ribbon bookmark, expandable inner pocket, and elastic closure band. The trusted companion of thinkers and creators worldwide.

name: Parker Jotter Stainless Steel Fountain Pen (Medium Nib)
description: Iconic Parker Jotter design in stainless steel with high-shine trims and signature arrowhead clip. Equipped with a stainless steel feather-shaped nib for a smooth, refined writing experience.

name: The Pragmatic Programmer: 20th Anniversary Edition by David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
description: One of the most significant books in modern software engineering. Illustrates best practices and major pitfalls of software development across architecture, code craftsmanship, and career growth.

name: The Three-Body Problem Trilogy Boxset by Cixin Liu
description: The complete Hugo Award-winning hard sci-fi trilogy featuring The Three-Body Problem, The Dark Forest, and Death's End in a collectible slipcased paperback edition.

name: BookHaven Premium Leather Folio Case for Kindle Paperwhite
description: Handcrafted vintage genuine leather protective case with auto sleep/wake magnetic closure and soft microfiber lining designed specifically for Kindle Paperwhite 6.8-inch.

name: Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman
description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman's seminal work explaining the two systems that drive the way we think: System 1 (fast, intuitive, emotional) and System 2 (slower, more deliberative, logical).
